responsibility: Implements the buffered token stream for the `clex` scanner, including token bucket storage, include-file/source tracking, token number to line/file lookup, token insertion and rewinding for repeated passes, and a lightweight macro table that can expand defined identifiers back into buffered tokens. It consumes raw tokens from `cflex` via `AddTok*`, records associated names, integers, and source locations, and produces a replayable token stream for later parsing and diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of the CLexBuf pair: it realizes the token buckets, source/include tracking records, token-number lookups, insertion/rewind behavior, and macro definition/expansion logic behind the interface declared in CLexBuf.def. Unlike the .def file, it contains the concrete replay buffer and cflex-facing token ingestion code.
